SELECT prd_issueplan_code prdIssuePlanCode, prd_issueplan_name prdIssuePlanName, TO_CHAR(vdate, 'yyyy-MM-dd') vdateStr, TO_CHAR(edate, 'yyyy-MM-dd') edateStr, '' AS prdPlanSerisId, '' AS planTargetAmtStr, '' AS planChangeAmtStr, '' AS strategyId, '' as configScaleStr, '' as assetType, '' as assetConfigScaleStr, remark remark, prd_issueplan_code childInfo, 'root' parentInfo, '02' hasChildren FROM prd_issueplan_info where 1=1
AND prd_issueplan_code = #{prdIssuePlanCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND vdate >= to_date(#{vdateStr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND edate <= to_date(#{edateStr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
AND vdate = to_date(#{vdateStr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
AND edate = to_date(#{edateStr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT '' as prdIssuePlanCode, '' as prdIssuePlanName, '' as vdateStr, '' as edateStr, ppd.PRD_PLAN_SERIS_NAME || '('|| pis.PRD_PLAN_SERIS_ID || ')' as prdPlanSerisId, to_char(ppd.plan_target_amt) as planTargetAmtStr, to_char(ppd.plan_change_amt) as planChangeAmtStr, '' as strategyId, '' as configScaleStr, '' as assetType, '' as assetConfigScaleStr, '' as remark, CONCAT(pis.PRD_ISSUEPLAN_CODE,pis.PRD_PLAN_SERIS_ID) as childInfo, pis.prd_issueplan_code as parentInfo, '02' hasChildren FROM PRD_ISSUEPLAN_STRATEGY pis left join PRD_PLAN_DETAIL ppd on pis.PRD_PLAN_SERIS_ID = ppd.PRD_PLAN_SERIS_ID
LEFT JOIN PRD_PLAN_INFO ppi ON ppi.PRD_PLAN_CODE = ppd.PRD_PLAN_CODE
left join prd_issueplan_info pip on pip.prd_issueplan_code = pis.prd_issueplan_code where 1=1
AND ppi.VDATE = pip.VDATE AND ppi.EDATE = pip.EDATE
AND pip.prd_issueplan_code = #{prdIssuePlanCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND vdate >= to_date(#{vdateStr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND edate <= to_date(#{edateStr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
AND vdate = to_date(#{vdateStr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
AND edate = to_date(#{edateStr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT '' as prdIssuePlanCode, '' as prdIssuePlanName, '' as vdateStr, '' as edateStr, '' as prdPlanSerisId, '' as planTargetAmtStr, '' as planChangeAmtStr, pis.STRATEGY_ID as strategyId, to_char(pis.COFING_SCALE) as configScaleStr, '' as assetType, '' as assetConfigScaleStr, '' as remark, CONCAT(CONCAT(pis.PRD_ISSUEPLAN_CODE,pis.PRD_PLAN_SERIS_ID),pis.strategy_id) as childInfo, CONCAT(pis.PRD_ISSUEPLAN_CODE,pis.PRD_PLAN_SERIS_ID) as parentInfo, '02' hasChildren FROM PRD_ISSUEPLAN_STRATEGY pis left join prd_issueplan_info pip on pip.prd_issueplan_code = pis.prd_issueplan_code where 1=1
AND pip.prd_issueplan_code = #{prdIssuePlanCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND vdate >= to_date(#{vdateStr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND edate <= to_date(#{edateStr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
AND vdate = to_date(#{vdateStr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
AND edate = to_date(#{edateStr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT '' as prdIssuePlanCode, '' as prdIssuePlanName, '' as vdateStr, '' as edateStr, '' as prdPlanSerisId, '' as planTargetAmtStr, '' as planChangeAmtStr, '' as strategyId, '' as configScaleStr, pis.asset_type as assetType, to_char(pis.COFING_SCALE) as assetConfigScaleStr, '' as remark, '' as childInfo, CONCAT(CONCAT(pis.PRD_ISSUEPLAN_CODE,pis.PRD_PLAN_SERIS_ID),pis.strategy_id) as parentInfo, '01' hasChildren FROM PRD_ISSU_STRATEGY_DETAIL pis left join prd_issueplan_info pip on pip.prd_issueplan_code = pis.prd_issueplan_code where 1=1
AND pip.prd_issueplan_code = #{prdIssuePlanCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND vdate >= to_date(#{vdateStr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND edate <= to_date(#{edateStr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
AND vdate = to_date(#{vdateStr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
AND edate = to_date(#{edateStr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-mm-dd')

SELECT prd_issueplan_code prdIssuePlanCode, prd_issueplan_name prdIssuePlanName, TO_CHAR(vdate, 'yyyy-MM-dd') vdateStr, TO_CHAR(edate, 'yyyy-MM-dd') edateStr, '' AS assetType, '' AS planTargetAmtStr, '' AS planChangeAmtStr, remark as remark,
CONCAT(prd_issueplan_code,'_SSS') childInfo,
'root' parentInfo, '02' hasChildren FROM prd_issueplan_info where 1=1
AND prd_issueplan_code = #{prdIssuePlanCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND vdate >= to_date(#{vdateStr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND edate <= to_date(#{edateStr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
AND vdate = to_date(#{vdateStr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
AND edate = to_date(#{edateStr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
UNION ALL SELECT '' AS prdIssuePlanCode, '' AS prdIssuePlanName, NULL AS vdateStr, NULL AS edateStr, pia.asset_type AS assetType, TO_CHAR(pia.plan_target_amt) AS planTargetAmtStr, TO_CHAR(pia.remain_change_amt) AS planChangeAmtStr, '' as remark, '' AS childInfo,
CONCAT(pia.prd_issueplan_code,'_SSS') AS parentInfo,
'01' hasChildren FROM prd_issueplan_asset_datail pia left join prd_issueplan_info pip on pip.prd_issueplan_code = pia.prd_issueplan_code where 1=1
AND pip.prd_issueplan_code = #{prdIssuePlanCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND vdate >= to_date(#{vdateStr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND edate <= to_date(#{edateStr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
AND vdate = to_date(#{vdateStr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
AND edate = to_date(#{edateStr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-mm-dd')

SELECT apd.asset_type assetType, apd.plan_target_amt/10000 planTargetAmt, apd.plan_change_amt/10000 planChangeAmt FROM asset_plan_detail apd LEFT JOIN asset_plan_info api ON apd.asset_plan_code = api.asset_plan_code where api.vdate = to_date(#{vdate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') and api.edate = to_date(#{edate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')

SELECT isd.strategy_id strategyId, isd.ratio ratio, isdc.type_2 assetType FROM ptl_inv_strategy_detail isd LEFT JOIN ptl_inv_strategy_detail_class isdc ON isd.batch_id = isdc.batch_id where isd.strategy_id = #{strategyId, jdbcType = VARCHAR}
SELECT PRD_ISSUEPLAN_CODE prdIssuePlanCode, PRD_ISSUEPLAN_NAME prdIssuePlanName, VDATE vdate, EDATE edate, REMARK remark FROM PRD_ISSUEPLAN_INFO where PRD_ISSUEPLAN_CODE = #{code, jdbcType = VARCHAR}

SELECT pis.count_order as orders, pis.PRD_PLAN_SERIS_ID as prdPlanSerisName, ppd.PLAN_TARGET_AMT as planTargetAmt, pis.REMAIN_CHANGE_AMT as planChangeAmt, pis.STRATEGY_ID as strategyId, pis.COFING_SCALE as configScale FROM PRD_ISSUEPLAN_STRATEGY pis left join PRD_PLAN_DETAIL ppd on pis.PRD_PLAN_SERIS_ID = ppd.PRD_PLAN_SERIS_ID LEFT JOIN PRD_PLAN_INFO ppi ON ppi.PRD_PLAN_CODE = ppd.PRD_PLAN_CODE left join prd_issueplan_info pip on pip.prd_issueplan_code = pis.prd_issueplan_code where pis.prd_issueplan_code = #{code, jdbcType = VARCHAR} AND ppi.VDATE = pip.VDATE AND ppi.EDATE = pip.EDATE
SELECT ASSET_TYPE assetType, PLAN_TARGET_AMT planTargetAmt, REMAIN_CHANGE_AMT planChangeAmt FROM PRD_ISSUEPLAN_ASSET_DATAIL where prd_issueplan_code = #{code, jdbcType = VARCHAR}
SELECT PRD_ISSUEPLAN_CODE id, PRD_ISSUEPLAN_NAME text FROM PRD_ISSUEPLAN_INFO
